identities.identity_scope: Specific PBS blend with 10 wt.% softwood kraft lignin Indulin AT relative to total polymer mass; source B10 simple-blend series, not DCP-reactive R10. Section 2.3 describes separately extruded physical formulations, and Table 6 reports their separately measured tensile results. The 10, 20 and 30 wt.% formulations differ in lignin mass fraction; they are not additional identities for processing state, test repeats or translated labels. Broad composite category denotes lignin-filled polymer, not an engineered continuous-fiber laminate. Section 2.1 gives the unresolved combined designation BioPBS FZ91PM/FZ91PB; no single grade is selected or inferred. Bxx/Rxx are study formulation labels, not certified grades.

processing.text: Source §2.3: separate 50 g formulations single-screw extruded at 140 °C into 3 mm strands and pelletized; portions compounded in Dynisco LMM at 100 rpm for 10 min at 140 °C, then injection-molded into dog-bone specimens.
processing.notes: Hot-pressed 120 °C discs are a separate preparation route. Acetone/DCP drying conditions belong to the reactive series and are not assigned to this simple blend.
